## Feature Summary

Describe the feature or improvement you propose.

## Problem or Motivation

What limitation does this feature address? Why would it be useful?

## Proposed Solution

Explain how you think the feature should work.

## Affected Subsystem

- [ ] Mobile phone IP camera
- [ ] Python / OpenCV colour detection
- [ ] Python / OpenCV shape detection
- [ ] ESP32 firmware
- [ ] Wi-Fi communication
- [ ] Conveyor and motor control
- [ ] Sensors or servo mechanism
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] Mechanical design
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Expected Behaviour

Describe what the system should do after the feature is implemented.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches you have considered.

## Additional Information

Include relevant diagrams, photographs, examples or technical references.

Do not include Wi-Fi passwords, private credentials or other sensitive information.
